comparison.objective: Install and orient a split-core current sensor around exactly one conductor, not adjust damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Selects the line conductor, orients the sensor, encloses it, and closes or latches its hinged core.
comparison.success_condition: Latched around line only, arrow within 25 degrees toward load, released and still versus two safe damper cycles.
comparison.reason: Hinged enclosure and semantic conductor selection test a different ability.
